newsitem.title: USA: Coffee vs gun in U.S. road rage case.
newsitem.headline: Coffee vs gun in U.S. road rage case.

text.p: Two motorists were arrested on Wednesday after one threw a cup of coffee at the other's vehicle and the other shot back in what police called a case of road rage.
Police said one of the men, in a dump truck, was tailing the other, who was driving a car. When he was finally able to pass the car, he threw his cup of coffee at it.
The driver of the car fired a shot from a .25 calibre gun at the truck, but missed.
No one was injured in the incident on Interstate-91 in the Hartford suburb of Windsor, but it created a huge traffic jam during the morning rush hour.
State Police Sgt. Dale Hourigan called it a case of road rage.
"It's just a situation where we have a person who is trying to get through traffic, was frustrated, and he got angry and threw a cup of coffee, and the other person had a gun," Hourigan said.
A state police spokeswoman said the names of the drivers were not immediately available. Both were from Massachusetts.
